earlier_sources: https://github.com/librefonts/galindo at dc5fea52318d56672b1e3f000851806c8b5bd2cc: src/Galindo-Regular-TTF.vfb, a FontLab import of the shipped font, not a source: Simon on google/fonts#10490 ("batch-converted from the binary files").
disclose: The released font is hinted (TrueType instructions). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.

The build's GSUB numbers or packs some lookups differently from the release's (fontc places a lookup that only a contextual lookup calls, and packs chained contextual rules, its own way: gfonts-ai-usage-report 22-fontc-problems, problems 12 and 13); every rule is the same and the text shapes identically (tools/functional_gate.py). Decided 2026-10-02: problems that need fontc are disclosed and fixed in fontc later.
